stories.title: NBA City Edition Uniform Reveal — 10th Anniversary

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Nike just dropped ALL 30 NBA City Edition uniforms at once.

10th anniversary. Every team remixing its best look from the past 9 years. Iridescent Swoosh. NBA logo moved to the back neck.

Which jersey wins? #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The Specter Edition is here.

Lakers, Celtics, Warriors, Knicks, 76ers, Pistons, Hawks and Kings all get a brand-new 5th uniform for 2026-27.

Nike going all-out for the City Edition 10th anniversary. Which Specter design takes the crown? #NBAUniform

stories.title: Stephen Curry Extension — 13 Days to Media Day

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
13 days until Warriors media day (Sept. 28).

Steph Curry is eligible for a 2-year, $136.7M extension. Still not signed.

The Warriors say: whatever Steph wants, he gets.

The ball is literally in his court. #DubNation #Warriors

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The Warriors are letting Steph Curry write his own contract extension.

Two years. $136.7M. Media day Sept. 28. Camp opens Sept. 29.

One of the biggest offseason decisions in the NBA and nothing is done yet.

#Warriors #NBA

stories.title: Jalen Duren Pistons Qualifying Offer Deadline

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Jalen Duren is leaning toward taking the $9.6M qualifying offer.

Detroit won't move from their 5-yr/$190M offer. He wants $40M+ AAV. Oct. 1 deadline is 16 days out.

If he accepts, Duren becomes an UFA next summer. Pistons lose matching rights.

#Pistons #NBA
